Script.name: Core
Script.script:
-- A reload owns a fresh runtime, but retains only validated profile settings. if dem and type(dem.shutdown) == 'function' then dem.shutdown() end dem = { separator = '&&', runtime = {timers = {}, handlers = {}, gmcpFields = {}}, settings = {areas = {}, hpLimit = 30, manaLimit = 10} } local owner = dem local active = true
function dem.trim(value) return type(value) == 'string' and (value:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')) or '' end
function dem.norm(value) return dem.trim(value):gsub('%s+', ' '):lower() end
function dem.validReference(value) if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil, 'Target must be one word.' end -- Only ordinary surrounding spaces are harmless; tabs/newlines are rejected. local ref = value:gsub('^ +', ''):gsub(' +$', '') if ref == '' or not ref:match('^[A-Za-z0-9_%-]+$') then return nil, 'Target must contain only letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.' end return ref end
function dem.message(value) local text = '[Demonic] ' .. tostring(value) .. '\n' if type(echo) == 'function' then echo(text) elseif type(cecho) == 'function' then cecho(text) end end
function dem.now() if type(getEpoch) == 'function' then return getEpoch() end return os.time() end
function dem.cancel(key) local timer = dem.runtime.timers[key] dem.runtime.timers[key] = nil if timer and type(killTimer) == 'function' then killTimer(timer.id) end end
function dem.defer(key, seconds, callback) dem.cancel(key) if not active or type(tempTimer) ~= 'function' then return nil end local timer = {} dem.runtime.timers[key] = timer timer.id = tempTimer(seconds, function() if not active or dem ~= owner or owner.runtime.timers[key] ~= timer then return end owner.runtime.timers[key] = nil callback() end) return timer.id end
function dem.bind(event, callback) if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= 'function' then return nil end local id = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, function(...) if active and dem == owner then return callback(...) end end) dem.runtime.handlers[#dem.runtime.handlers + 1] = id return id end
function dem.schedule() if not active or dem.runtime.timers['hunt-step'] then return end dem.defer('hunt-step', 0, function() if dem.hunt and type(dem.hunt.step) == 'function' then dem.hunt.step() end end) end
function dem.joinCommands(commands) if type(commands) ~= 'table' or #commands == 0 then return nil, 'No commands supplied.' end for i = 1, #commands do if type(commands[i]) ~= 'string' or dem.trim(commands[i]) == '' or commands[i]:find('[%c]') then return nil, 'Commands must be nonempty single-line strings.' end end return table.concat(commands, dem.separator) end
local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == 'function' and getMudletHomeDir() or '.' dem.settingsPath = home .. '/Demonic-settings.lua' local loaded = {} if type(table.load) == 'function' then pcall(table.load, dem.settingsPath, loaded) end for _, field in ipairs({'hpLimit', 'manaLimit'}) do local value = tonumber(loaded[field]) if value and value == value and value >= 0 and value <= 100 then dem.settings[field] = value end end if type(loaded.areas) == 'table' then for area, names in pairs(loaded.areas) do -- Room.Info area labels are opaque keys; preserve their spelling on reload. local key = type(area) == 'string' and area or '' if dem.trim(key) ~= '' and type(names) == 'table' then dem.settings.areas[key] = dem.settings.areas[key] or {} for name, allowed in pairs(names) do local normalized = dem.norm(name) if normalized ~= '' and allowed == true then dem.settings.areas[key][normalized] = true end end end end end
function dem.saveSettings() if type(table.save) ~= 'function' then dem.message('Settings could not be saved: table.save unavailable.'); return false end local ok, err = pcall(table.save, dem.settingsPath, dem.settings) if not ok then dem.message('Settings could not be saved: ' .. tostring(err)) end return ok end
function dem.shutdown() if not active then return end active = false if dem.hunt then if type(dem.hunt.stop) == 'function' then dem.hunt.stop('Package stopped.') else dem.hunt.enabled = false end end local keys = {} for key in pairs(dem.runtime.timers) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end for _, key in ipairs(keys) do dem.cancel(key) end for _, id in ipairs(dem.runtime.handlers) do if type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == 'function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(id) end end dem.runtime.handlers = {} end

Script.name: Targeting
Script.script:
dem.targeting = {kind = nil, source = nil} local targeting = dem.targeting
local function change(ref, kind, source) source = source or 'manual' local previous = dem.target dem.target = ref targeting.kind, targeting.source = kind, source -- The scheduler sees selection changes immediately, even between prompts. if dem.hunt and type(dem.hunt.onTargetChanged) == 'function' then dem.hunt.onTargetChanged(previous, ref, kind, source) end if type(raiseEvent) == 'function' then raiseEvent('dem.targetChanged', previous, ref, kind, source) end return true end
local function select(ref, kind, source) local valid, err = dem.validReference(ref) if not valid then dem.message(err); return false, err end return change(valid, kind, source) end
function targeting.setPlayer(ref, source) return select(ref, 'player', source) end function targeting.setDenizen(ref, source) return select(ref, 'denizen', source) end function targeting.clear(source) return change(nil, nil, source) end function targeting.get() return dem.target end

Script.name: Balances and Vitals
Script.script:
dem.vitals = {hp = nil, maxhp = nil, mp = nil, maxmp = nil, stunned = nil, prone = nil} dem.balances = {bal = nil, eq = nil, action = nil} local balances = dem.balances
local function number(value) local result = tonumber(value) if result and result == result and result ~= math.huge and result ~= -math.huge then return result end end
local function boolean(value) if value == true or value == 1 or value == '1' then return true end if value == false or value == 0 or value == '0' then return false end end
local function release() balances.action = nil dem.cancel('attack-watchdog') end
local function readiness(kind, ready, explicitRecovery) balances[kind] = ready if kind == 'bal' and balances.action then if ready == false then balances.action.lost = true elseif ready == true and (explicitRecovery or balances.action.lost) then release() end end end
local function stopIfDead(dead) if dead == true or (dem.vitals.hp and dem.vitals.hp <= 0) then if dem.hunt and type(dem.hunt.stop) == 'function' then dem.hunt.stop('You are dead.') elseif dem.hunt then dem.hunt.enabled = false end end end
function balances.onVitals(payload) if type(payload) ~= 'table' then return end for _, field in ipairs({'hp', 'maxhp', 'mp', 'maxmp'}) do if payload[field] ~= nil then local value = number(payload[field]) dem.vitals[field] = value -- Invalid explicit data invalidates knowledge; it does not override text fallback. if value ~= nil then dem.runtime.gmcpFields[field] = true end end end for _, field in ipairs({'stunned', 'prone'}) do if payload[field] ~= nil then local value = boolean(payload[field]) dem.vitals[field] = value if value ~= nil then dem.runtime.gmcpFields[field] = true end end end for _, kind in ipairs({'bal', 'eq'}) do if payload[kind] ~= nil then local value = boolean(payload[kind]) readiness(kind, value) if value ~= nil then dem.runtime.gmcpFields[kind] = true end end end stopIfDead(boolean(payload.dead)) dem.schedule() end
function balances.taken(kind, seconds) if kind ~= 'bal' and kind ~= 'eq' then return false end readiness(kind, false) -- Duration is diagnostic only. A clock cannot confirm recovery. balances[kind .. 'Duration'] = number(seconds) dem.schedule() return true end
function balances.recovered(kind) if kind ~= 'bal' and kind ~= 'eq' then return false end readiness(kind, true, true) dem.schedule() return true end
function balances.beginAction(action) if type(action) ~= 'table' or balances.action then return false end action.lost = balances.bal == false balances.action = action -- Local pessimism gates sends; it is not evidence of a server balance cycle. balances.bal = false return true end
function balances.parsePrompt(text) if type(text) ~= 'string' then return end local fields = dem.runtime.gmcpFields local function vitals(field, value) if value and not fields[field] then dem.vitals[field] = number(value) end end local hp, mp = text:match('Health:%s*(%d+)%s+Mana:%s*(%d+)') vitals('hp', hp); vitals('mp', mp) local hp2, maxhp, mp2, maxmp = text:match('H:%s*(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)%s+M:%s*(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)') vitals('hp', hp2); vitals('maxhp', maxhp); vitals('mp', mp2); vitals('maxmp', maxmp) local eq, bal = text:match('%(([e%-])([b%-])%)') if eq and not fields.eq then readiness('eq', eq == 'e') end if bal and not fields.bal then readiness('bal', bal == 'b') end stopIfDead() dem.schedule() end
function balances.endPrompt() dem.runtime.gmcpFields = {} end
function balances.reset() release() balances.bal, balances.eq = nil, nil balances.balDuration, balances.eqDuration = nil, nil dem.vitals = {hp = nil, maxhp = nil, mp = nil, maxmp = nil, stunned = nil, prone = nil} dem.runtime.gmcpFields = {} end

Script.name: Room Tracking
Script.script:
-- Room packets are an ordered stream. A movement prompt barrier discards the -- preceding room's queued packets; GMCP has no generation tag for arbitrary -- delayed, untagged replies, so the package cannot identify those by room ID. dem.room = {items = {}, order = {}, retired = {}, ready = false, phase = 'barrier'} local room = dem.room
local function id(value) if type(value) ~= 'string' and type(value) ~= 'number' then return nil end local s = tostring(value) if not s:match('^%d+$') then return nil end s = s:gsub('^0+', '') if s == '' then return nil end return s end
local function record(value, previous) if type(value) ~= 'table' then return nil end local key = id(value.id) if not key then return nil end local result = {} for k, v in pairs(previous or {}) do result[k] = v end for k, v in pairs(value) do result[k] = v end result.id = key return result, key end
local function changed() if dem.schedule then dem.schedule() end end
function room.eligible(item) if type(item) ~= 'table' or not id(item.id) or type(item.name) ~= 'string' then return false end local attr = type(item.attrib) == 'string' and item.attrib:lower() or '' return attr:find('m', 1, true) ~= nil and not attr:find('d', 1, true) and not attr:find('x', 1, true) end
function room.reset() room.num, room.area = nil, nil room.items, room.order, room.retired = {}, {}, {} room.ready, room.phase, room.subscribed = false, 'barrier', false end
function room.subscribe() if room.subscribed then return end room.subscribed = true if type(sendGMCP) == 'function' then sendGMCP('Core.Supports.Add ["Char 1","Char.Items 1","Room 1"]') end end
function room.request() if not room.num then return false end -- Never bypass the first actual prompt after a movement packet. if room.phase == 'barrier' then room.ready = false; return false end room.ready, room.phase = false, 'waiting' if type(sendGMCP) == 'function' then sendGMCP('Char.Items.Room') end return true end
function room.onInfo(payload) if type(payload) ~= 'table' then return end local number = id(payload.num) if not number then return end if number ~= room.num then room.num = number room.area = type(payload.area) == 'string' and payload.area or nil if dem.trim(room.area) == '' then room.area = nil end room.items, room.order, room.retired = {}, {}, {} room.ready, room.phase = false, 'barrier' if dem.hunt then dem.hunt.onRoomChanged() end elseif payload.area ~= nil then room.area = type(payload.area) == 'string' and payload.area or nil if dem.trim(room.area) == '' then room.area = nil end end changed() end
function room.onPrompt() if room.num and room.phase == 'barrier' then room.phase = 'waiting' room.request() end end
function room.onList(payload) if not room.num or room.phase == 'barrier' or type(payload) ~= 'table' or payload.location ~= 'room' or type(payload.items) ~= 'table' then return end local items, order = {}, {} for _, value in ipairs(payload.items) do local item, key = record(value) if item then if not items[key] then order[#order + 1] = key end items[key] = item end end local old = room.items room.items, room.order, room.ready, room.phase = items, order, true, 'ready' for key in pairs(old) do if not items[key] then room.retired[key] = true if dem.hunt then dem.hunt.onRemoved(key) end end end changed() end
local function delta(payload, liveAdd) if not room.num or room.phase == 'barrier' or type(payload) ~= 'table' or payload.location ~= 'room' then return end local value = payload.item local key = type(value) == 'table' and id(value.id) or nil if not key then return end local item = record(value, room.items[key]) if not item then return end if not room.items[key] then room.order[#room.order + 1] = key end room.items[key] = item if liveAdd then room.retired[key] = nil end changed() end
function room.onAdd(payload) delta(payload, true) end function room.onUpdate(payload) delta(payload, false) end
function room.onRemove(payload) if not room.num or room.phase == 'barrier' or type(payload) ~= 'table' or payload.location ~= 'room' then return end local value = payload.item local key = id(type(value) == 'table' and value.id or value) if not key then return end room.items[key], room.retired[key] = nil, true for i = #room.order, 1, -1 do if room.order[i] == key then table.remove(room.order, i) end end if dem.hunt then dem.hunt.onRemoved(key) end changed() end
-- This lookup may use a known same-room snapshot while its refresh is pending. -- It is for target ownership/removal only; resolve() below gates all attacks. function room.identify(reference) if not room.num or room.phase == 'barrier' then return nil, 'The room identity is not ready.' end local valid = dem.validReference(reference) if not valid then return nil, 'Invalid denizen reference.' end local ref, found, foundKey = valid:lower(), nil, nil for _, key in ipairs(room.order) do local item = room.items[key] if item and not room.retired[key] then local matches = ref == key if type(item.name) == 'string' then for word in item.name:lower():gmatch('[%w]+') do if word ~= 'a' and word ~= 'an' and word ~= 'the' then if ref == word or ref == word .. key then matches = true end end end end if matches then if foundKey and foundKey ~= key then return nil, 'That denizen reference is ambiguous.' end found, foundKey = item, key end end end if not found then return nil, 'That denizen is not in the current room.' end return found, foundKey end
function room.resolve(reference) if not room.ready then return nil, 'The room roster is not ready.' end return room.identify(reference) end

Script.name: Hunt Controller
Script.script:
dem.hunt = {enabled = false, reason = 'Disabled.'} local hunt = dem.hunt local selected, manualReference, stateWaiting, watchedAction
local function message(text) dem.message(text) end local function schedule() if dem.schedule then dem.schedule() end end local function cancelState() stateWaiting = false dem.cancel('state-watchdog') end local function waitForState(reason) hunt.reason = reason or 'Waiting for room or character data.' if stateWaiting then return end stateWaiting = true dem.defer('state-watchdog', 10, function() if hunt.enabled and stateWaiting then hunt.stop('Required room or character data did not arrive.') end end) end local function watchAction(action) if watchedAction == action then return end watchedAction = action local elapsed = math.max(0, dem.now() - (action.started or dem.now())) dem.defer('attack-watchdog', math.max(0, 10 - elapsed), function() if hunt.enabled and dem.balances.action == action then hunt.stop('The last attack has not completed a confirmed balance cycle.') end end) end local function clearOwned() if dem.targeting.source == 'hunt' then dem.targeting.clear('hunt') end end
function hunt.stop(reason) local wasEnabled = hunt.enabled hunt.enabled = false hunt.reason = reason or 'Disabled by user.' cancelState() dem.cancel('attack-watchdog') watchedAction, selected, manualReference = nil, nil, nil clearOwned() if wasEnabled then message('Hunt mode off' .. (reason and ': ' .. reason or '.')) end end
function hunt.toggle() if hunt.enabled then hunt.stop(); return false end if dem.targeting.kind == 'player' then dem.targeting.clear('hunt') end manualReference = dem.targeting.kind == 'denizen' and dem.targeting.source == 'manual' and dem.target or nil selected, hunt.enabled = nil, true dem.room.subscribe() dem.room.request() waitForState('Waiting for a fresh room roster.') message('Hunt mode on.') schedule() return true end
function hunt.onRoomChanged() selected, manualReference = nil, nil if dem.targeting.kind == 'denizen' then dem.targeting.clear('hunt') end if hunt.enabled then waitForState('Waiting for the new room roster.') end end
function hunt.onTargetChanged(oldReference, reference, kind, source) if source == 'hunt' or not hunt.enabled then return end selected = nil if not reference then hunt.stop('The shared target was cleared.'); return end if kind == 'player' then hunt.stop('A player target was selected.'); return end manualReference = reference -- Retain known same-room ownership even during refresh, so a Remove packet -- can end this exception. step() still requires the fresh roster to attack. local item, key = dem.room.identify(reference) if item then selected = {reference = reference, key = key, room = dem.room.num, item = item, manual = true} if dem.room.ready and not dem.room.eligible(item) then hunt.stop('The selected denizen is dead or protected.'); return end elseif dem.room.ready then hunt.stop(key); return end schedule() end
local function finite(value) return type(value) == 'number' and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge end local function knownVitals() local v = dem.vitals return v and finite(v.hp) and finite(v.maxhp) and v.maxhp > 0 and v.hp >= 0 and finite(v.mp) and finite(v.maxmp) and v.maxmp > 0 and v.mp >= 0 end local function areaList() return dem.room.area and dem.settings.areas[dem.room.area] or nil end local function choose() local room = dem.room if manualReference then local item, key = room.resolve(manualReference) if not item then hunt.stop(key); return nil end if not room.eligible(item) then hunt.stop('The selected denizen is dead or protected.'); return nil end return {reference = manualReference, key = key, room = room.num, item = item, manual = true} end local allowed = areaList() if selected and selected.room == room.num then local item = room.items[selected.key] if item and not room.retired[selected.key] and room.eligible(item) and allowed and allowed[dem.norm(item.name)] then selected.item = item return selected end end selected = nil if allowed then for _, key in ipairs(room.order) do local item = room.items[key] if item and not room.retired[key] and room.eligible(item) and allowed[dem.norm(item.name)] then return {reference = key, key = key, room = room.num, item = item, manual = false} end end end clearOwned() return nil end
function hunt.step() if not hunt.enabled then return end local v, b, room = dem.vitals, dem.balances, dem.room -- A known low percentage stops immediately, even while another field is missing. if v and finite(v.hp) and finite(v.maxhp) and v.maxhp > 0 and v.hp / v.maxhp * 100 <= dem.settings.hpLimit then hunt.stop('Health reached the configured limit.'); return end if v and finite(v.mp) and finite(v.maxmp) and v.maxmp > 0 and v.mp / v.maxmp * 100 <= dem.settings.manaLimit then hunt.stop('Mana reached the configured limit.'); return end if not knownVitals() or not room.ready or not room.num or b.bal == nil or b.eq == nil or v.prone == nil or v.stunned == nil then waitForState(); return end cancelState() if manualReference then local item, key = room.resolve(manualReference) if not item then hunt.stop(key); return end if not room.eligible(item) then hunt.stop('The selected denizen is dead or protected.'); return end selected = {reference = manualReference, key = key, room = room.num, item = item, manual = true} end if b.action then hunt.reason = 'Waiting for the confirmed attack balance cycle.'; watchAction(b.action); return end watchedAction = nil if not b.bal or not b.eq then hunt.reason = 'Waiting for balance and equilibrium.'; return end if v.prone or v.stunned then hunt.reason = 'Waiting until standing and unstunned.'; return end local cost = dem.ritualism.manaCost({'fire', 'ice'}) if not cost or v.mp < cost then hunt.reason = 'Waiting for enough mana for the full attack.'; return end local candidate = choose() if not candidate then if hunt.enabled then hunt.reason = 'No eligible allowed denizens in this room.' end return end if not hunt.enabled then return end selected = candidate if not candidate.manual and dem.target ~= candidate.reference then dem.targeting.setDenizen(candidate.reference, 'hunt') end -- Target-change callbacks are synchronous; recheck before committing the send. if not hunt.enabled or dem.target ~= candidate.reference or b.action then return end local command, err = dem.ritualism.buildTrace({'fire', 'ice'}, dem.target) if not command then hunt.stop(err or 'Cannot build the hunting attack.'); return end local action = {reference = dem.target, key = candidate.key, room = room.num, item = candidate.item, retired = false, started = dem.now()} if not b.beginAction(action) then return end hunt.lastAction = action hunt.reason = 'Waiting for the confirmed attack balance cycle.' watchAction(action) send(command) end
local function retire(action) if not action or action.retired then return end action.retired = true if action.room ~= dem.room.num then return end dem.room.retired[action.key] = true -- Lifecycle messages belong to the immutable submitted action, never to a -- subsequently selected manual target. if dem.target == action.reference and selected and selected.key == action.key and selected.room == action.room then manualReference, selected = nil, nil dem.targeting.clear('hunt') end if hunt.enabled then dem.room.request(); waitForState(); schedule() end end
function hunt.onKill(name) local action = hunt.lastAction if action and type(name) == 'string' and action.item and dem.norm(action.item.name) == dem.norm(name) then retire(action) end end function hunt.onMissing() retire(hunt.lastAction) end
function hunt.onRemoved(key) local action = hunt.lastAction if action and action.key == key and action.room == dem.room.num then action.retired = true end if selected and selected.key == key and selected.room == dem.room.num then selected, manualReference = nil, nil dem.targeting.clear('hunt') elseif manualReference and dem.room.ready then -- An ID may disappear before the pending manual selection reaches step(). local item, foundKey = dem.room.resolve(manualReference) if item and foundKey == key then manualReference = nil end end schedule() end
local function validName(name) if type(name) ~= 'string' then return nil end name = dem.norm(name) if name == '' or name:find('[%c]') then return nil end return name end local function reject(reason) message(reason) return nil, reason end function hunt.add(name) local area = dem.room.area if not area then return reject('The current area is unknown.') end name = validName(name) if not name then return reject('Supply the full denizen name.') end dem.settings.areas[area] = dem.settings.areas[area] or {} dem.settings.areas[area][name] = true dem.saveSettings() message('Added ' .. name .. ' in ' .. area .. '.') schedule() return true end function hunt.remove(name) local area = dem.room.area if not area then return reject('The current area is unknown.') end name = validName(name) if not name then return reject('Supply the full denizen name.') end if dem.settings.areas[area] then dem.settings.areas[area][name] = nil end dem.saveSettings() message('Removed ' .. name .. ' in ' .. area .. '.') if selected and not selected.manual and dem.norm(selected.item.name) == name then selected = nil; clearOwned() end schedule() return true end function hunt.list() if not dem.room.area then message('The current area is unknown.'); return nil end local names = {} for name, allowed in pairs(areaList() or {}) do if allowed then names[#names + 1] = name end end table.sort(names) message(dem.room.area .. ': ' .. (#names > 0 and table.concat(names, ', ') or '(no allowed denizens)')) return names end function hunt.status() local v, b = dem.vitals, dem.balances local function value(n) return n ~= nil and tostring(n) or 'unknown' end message('Hunt mode ' .. (hunt.enabled and 'on' or 'off') .. '; area: ' .. (dem.room.area or 'unknown') .. '; target: ' .. (dem.target or 'none') .. '; limits: ' .. dem.settings.hpLimit .. '% health, ' .. dem.settings.manaLimit .. '% mana; HP: ' .. value(v.hp) .. '/' .. value(v.maxhp) .. '; MP: ' .. value(v.mp) .. '/' .. value(v.maxmp) .. '; balance: ' .. value(b.bal) .. '; equilibrium: ' .. value(b.eq) .. '; ' .. hunt.reason) return hunt.enabled end function hunt.setLimits(hp, mana) hp, mana = tonumber(hp), tonumber(mana) if not finite(hp) or not finite(mana) or hp < 0 or hp > 100 or mana < 0 or mana > 100 then return reject('Limits must be percentages between 0 and 100.') end dem.settings.hpLimit, dem.settings.manaLimit = hp, mana dem.saveSettings() schedule() return true end

Script.name: Ritualism Commands
Script.script:
dem.ritualism = {duality = true, costs = {fire = 9, ice = 9}} local ritualism = dem.ritualism
local function validSymbols(symbols) if type(symbols) ~= 'table' or #symbols < 1 or #symbols > 2 then return nil, 'Trace requires one or two symbols.' end for i = 1, #symbols do if type(symbols[i]) ~= 'string' or not symbols[i]:match('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_%-]*$') then return nil, 'Invalid ritualism symbol.' end end return true end
function ritualism.buildTrace(symbols, ref) local ok, err = validSymbols(symbols) if not ok then return nil, err end if #symbols == 2 and not ritualism.duality then return nil, 'Duality is not learned.' end local target, targetErr = dem.validReference(ref) if not target then return nil, targetErr end return 'trace ' .. table.concat(symbols, ' ') .. ' ' .. target end
function ritualism.manaCost(symbols) if not validSymbols(symbols) then return nil end local total = 0 for _, symbol in ipairs(symbols) do local cost = ritualism.costs[symbol] if type(cost) ~= 'number' then return nil end total = total + cost end return total end

Script.name: Initialize Demonic
Script.script:
-- Register only after every System and profession module has been loaded. function dem.onPrompt(text) dem.cancel('hunt-step') if text then dem.balances.parsePrompt(text) end dem.room.onPrompt() dem.hunt.step() dem.balances.endPrompt() end
function dem.resetConnection() dem.hunt.stop('Connection changed; type hunt to enable again.') dem.hunt.lastAction = nil dem.targeting.clear('system') dem.balances.reset() dem.room.reset() end
local function gmcpHandler(event, fn) dem.bind('gmcp.' .. event, function() local value = gmcp for field in event:gmatch('[^.]+') do value = type(value) == 'table' and value[field] or nil end if type(value) == 'table' then fn(value) end end) end
gmcpHandler('Char.Vitals', dem.balances.onVitals) gmcpHandler('Room.Info', dem.room.onInfo) gmcpHandler('Char.Items.List', dem.room.onList) gmcpHandler('Char.Items.Add', dem.room.onAdd) gmcpHandler('Char.Items.Remove', dem.room.onRemove) gmcpHandler('Char.Items.Update', dem.room.onUpdate) dem.bind('sysDisconnectionEvent', dem.resetConnection) dem.bind('sysConnectionEvent', dem.resetConnection) dem.bind('sysProtocolEnabled', function(_, protocol) if protocol == 'GMCP' then dem.room.subscribe() end end) dem.bind('sysExitEvent', function() dem.saveSettings(); dem.shutdown() end) dem.bind('sysUninstall', function(_, package) if package == 'Demonic' then dem.saveSettings(); dem.shutdown() end end)
-- Installation into an already-connected profile may precede the next packet. -- Hydrate vitals and room identity, but never trust a cached room item list. if type(gmcp) == 'table' then if gmcp.Char or gmcp.Room then dem.room.subscribe() end if gmcp.Char and type(gmcp.Char.Vitals) == 'table' then dem.balances.onVitals(gmcp.Char.Vitals) end if gmcp.Room and type(gmcp.Room.Info) == 'table' then dem.room.onInfo(gmcp.Room.Info) -- This identity was cached before installation, rather than received during -- a movement block. Request a fresh roster without waiting for game text. dem.room.onPrompt() end end
